description: Approved API breaking changes that should be ignored by the contract checker

entries.reason: Intentional: require exactly two criterion groups for log threshold ratio criteria so API validation matches executor validation and rejects malformed criteria (e.g. a single nested array) that previously saved but broke rule execution and the edit UI.

PUT request body uses UpdateOutputSchema with meta IDs, changing inline anyOf members to $ref components. Data shape is identical; adds otel_exporter_config_yaml field.

Security Solution sets max_signals default value in applyRuleDefaults and Zod schema. The latter started breaking rule PATCH API after Zod v4 migration by defaulting max_signals to 100 and overriding any existing value. Removing max_signals default value from the Zod schema to fix the issue,

oasdiff misreports this as removed anyOf subschemas because both agents branches gained maxLength (512 per agent ID, 500000 for the KQL string). The real change is a new length limit. Agent IDs are UUIDs, and 500000 covers the largest query the Fleet UI generates (a select-all selection excluding up to 10000 agent IDs), so no known valid request is affected.
